nodes.description: owner: privileged address stored in BotProtected, set to msg.sender in GenShards constructor
botProtection: external bot protection contract address invoked via low-level call
uniPair: computed address of the Uniswap wETH/token pair
checkBots modifier: performs a low-level call to botProtection with selector 0x15274141 and requires success
balanceOf: public mapping of holder balances
allowance: public nested mapping of spender allowances
totalSupply: total token supply fixed at 208969354000000000000000000
uniRouter: IUniswapV2Router02 instance at 0x7a250d...
wETH: wrapped ETH token address
transfer: payable external transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
transferFrom: guarded by checkBots, adjusts allowance and balances
approve: payable function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate: owner-only function executing arbitrary delegatecall
list: owner-only function adding liquidity via router and distributing balances
pairFor: internal pure CREATE2-style pair address derivation
GenShards constructor: sets owner, uniPair and infinite allowances
unsafe low-level .call to botProtection with abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141,...)
unsafe delegatecall to user-supplied address a with user-supplied bytes b
external payable call uniRouter.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value
msg.sender: untrusted caller identity
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable timestamp used as swap deadline
constructor parameter _botProtection
transferFrom parameter _from
transferFrom parameter _to
transferFrom parameter _value
approve parameter _spender
approve parameter _value
delegate parameter a (target address)
delegate parameter b (call data)
list parameter _numList (amount reserved for liquidity)
list parameter _tos (recipient array)
list parameter _amounts (amount array)
local bool notABot returned by botProtection call
local bytes isNotBot returned by botProtection call
